【原视频简介】
Have you ever wondered how enriched uranium is made? From deep underground mining to high-speed centrifuges and nuclear fuel production, uranium processing is one of the most complex and powerful industrial processes in the modern world.

In this video, we break down how uranium is extracted, refined, enriched, and transformed into nuclear fuel pellets. Discover how a material found in rock becomes the energy source powering millions of homes—and why even a tiny pellet can produce enormous amounts of electricity.

🎯 What You’ll Learn:

✅ What uranium is and how it was discovered
✅ The difference between uranium-238 and uranium-235
✅ How uranium ore is mined and processed
✅ What uranium enrichment is and how centrifuges work
✅ How nuclear fuel pellets are manufactured
✅ How nuclear reactors generate electricity

⚡ Topics Covered:

Uranium mining and high-grade deposits
Artificial ground freezing techniques
Crushing and chemical processing
Uranium hexafluoride gas conversion
Gas centrifuge enrichment process
Nuclear fuel pellet production
Fuel rods and reactor assemblies
Nuclear fission and energy generation

Enriched uranium is one of the most powerful materials ever used by humanity. From nuclear reactors to global energy production, it plays a critical role in generating electricity for millions of people worldwide.
